study type: Retrospective cohort study and literature review
outcome: Success rate of external cephalic version
cohort: 100 women with a prior cesarean section who underwent external cephalic version at term
finding: External cephalic version in women with a prior cesarean section was safe and successful in 50% of cases, with 63.8% of those who were successful going on to deliver vaginally.
mod_finding: This study examined the safety and efficacy of external cephalic version in women with a prior cesarean section.
